problems.heading: Most businesses do not need more marketing noise. They need fewer missed opportunities.
problems.intro: More traffic cannot fix slow follow-up, missed calls, weak landing pages or leads sitting in an inbox. We find the leaks between attention and booked business.

items.title: Missed calls
items.text: High-intent prospects call once, get no answer and move to the next provider.

items.title: Slow follow-up
items.text: Enquiries cool down while teams rely on manual replies and scattered inboxes.

items.title: Wasted ad spend
items.text: Paid traffic lands on pages that do not make the next step obvious or easy.

items.title: Disconnected systems
items.text: Ads, forms, CRM, email and reporting operate separately instead of moving one lead forward.

system.heading: From first click to booked business.
system.intro: We use the right channels and technology for the job, but the commercial system stays simple: attract the right people, convert them, follow up quickly and measure what became real business.

steps.title: Attract
steps.text: Generate relevant demand through local SEO, Google Ads, content and targeted campaigns.

steps.title: Convert
steps.text: Turn attention into calls and enquiries with clear offers, landing pages and low-friction forms.

steps.title: Follow up
steps.text: Use CRM, email, SMS and automation so every qualified lead gets a fast, consistent response.

steps.title: Book
steps.text: Build a practical handover from marketing enquiry to appointment, quote or sales conversation.

steps.title: Measure
steps.text: Report on qualified enquiries, cost per lead, booked opportunities and commercial outcomes—not vanity metrics.
